title: On the center of distances of finite ultrametric spaces
summary: The center of distances of a metric space $(X,d)$ is the set $C(X)$ of all $t\in \mathbb R^+$ for which the equation $d(x,p)=t$ has a solution for each $p\in X$. We prove the inequality $|C(X)| \le 1 + \lfloor \log_2 n \rfloor$ for all finite ultrametric spaces $(X,d)$ which have exactly $n$ points. It is also shown that for every integer $n \geq 1$ there exists a finite ultrametric space $(Y,ρ)$ such that $|Y| = n$ and $|C(Y)| = 1 + \log_2 \lfloor n \rfloor. $
